title: Rava bar Tuvia bar Yitzchak
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He reported in the name of Rav, Eruvin 28a. Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim omits bar Tuvia and judges this correct, identifying him with the well-known Rabbah bar Rav Yitzchak.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The heading has Rava bar Tuvia bar Yitzchak; Hyman’s proposed identification is Rabbah bar Rav Yitzchak. The omitted Tuvia and differing Rav father title remain explicit in that attributed proposal.

All fourteen Davidson paragraphs of Eruvin 28a were read and do not contain this named chain. The whole paragraph at 28b names Rabbah bar Toviyya bar Yitzchak reporting in Rav’s name. This is a separate positive comparison: the supplied 28a, Rava/Tuvia forms and Hyman’s Dikdukei Soferim report and identification remain unchanged. No father identity or locator repair follows.
